normal.en: The word started in calculus in 1816; a derivative is the rate extracted from a changing function.
normal.cn: 这个词 1816 年始于微积分；导数就是从变化函数中提取出的速率。

normal.en: Cells differentiate: one general cell becomes a separate, specialized kind.
normal.cn: 细胞分化：一个普通细胞变成独立而专门的种类。

normal.en: In 1876 the verb moved into ordinary speech: observe a difference and name it.
normal.cn: 1876 年这个词进入日常语言：观察差异并把它说出来。

normal.en: The reflexive pattern differentiate oneself draws the line between you and the crowd.
normal.cn: 反身搭配 differentiate oneself 把线画在你与人群之间。

abstract.en: Difference is a relation, not a thing: the line exists because someone draws it between two items.
abstract.cn: 差异是一种关系，不是实物：线之所以存在，是因为有人在两项之间画了它。

abstract.en: Specialization is narrowing: to become distinct, a cell gives up other possible identities.
abstract.cn: 专门化就是收窄：为了变得独特，一个细胞放弃了其他可能的身份。

abstract.en: The same separating act can be neutral (classification) or unjust (discrimination). The line itself does not decide its ethics.
abstract.cn: 同一种分开动作可以是中立的（分类），也可以是不义的（歧视）。线本身并不决定其伦理。

examples.en: Consumers cannot differentiate the two brands.
examples.cn: 消费者无法区分这两个品牌。

examples.en: Cells differentiate into muscle, nerve, or bone.
examples.cn: 细胞分化成肌肉、神经或骨骼细胞。

examples.en: She differentiated herself through original research.
examples.cn: 她以原创研究让自己脱颖而出。

dict_mnemonic.text: “different 加 -iate”——先看见 different（不同），再动手去分 → differentiate 区分

root: 拉丁语 differre“分开携带”，由 dis-“分开”+ ferre“携带”构成；名词 differentia 即“差异”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of differentiate, all built on one act: drawing a line between two things. The line can be perceptual, physical, biological, commercial, moral, or mathematical.
sensesIntro.cn: differentiate 的九个义项都建立在一个动作上：在两物之间画线。这条线可以是感知的、物理的、生物的、商业的、道德的或数学的。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fine line drawn between two nearly identical things.
core.cn: 核心意象：在两个几乎相同的事物之间画一条细线。

branches.en: SEE: the first move is mental — noticing that two things differ, or judging that a line must not be crossed.
branches.cn: 看见：第一步是心智动作——注意到两物不同，或判断某条界线不可逾越。

branches.en: MARK OFF: a visible trait, a classification rule, or a social standard separates one group from another.
branches.cn: 划开：可见特征、分类规则或社会标准，把一类与另一类分开。

branches.en: SPECIALIZE: in biology the separated part develops its own identity.
branches.cn: 专门化：在生物学中，被分开的部分发展出自己的身份。

branches.en: STAND OUT: in markets and careers, the line is drawn between a product or person and the crowd.
branches.cn: 脱颖而出：在市场与职业中，线画在产品或个人与人群之间。

branches.en: CALCULUS: the original mathematical operation extracts a rate of change.
branches.cn: 微积分：最早的数学运算提取变化速率。

intro.en: Differentiate is built from the Latin noun differentia plus the verb suffix -ate. English then adds -tion, -tion, and the negative prefix un- to make a whole family.
intro.cn: differentiate 由拉丁名词 differentia 加动词后缀 -ate 构成。英语再用 -tion 与否定前缀 un- 扩展出整个词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin differre 'carry apart' yields differens 'different' and differentia 'difference'; English also keeps the participle stem in different and differential.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 differre“分开携带”生成 differens“不同的”和 differentia“差异”；英语还在 different、differential 中保留分词词干。

items.meaningCN: 不同的（-ent 构成形容词）

items.meaning: the quality or state of being unlike
items.meaningCN: 差异；不同（-ence 构成名词）

items.meaning: relating to a difference; a small difference in amount
items.meaningCN: 微分的；差别的；差额（-ial 后缀）

items.meaning: the act of distinguishing, or the process of specialization
items.meaningCN: 区分；分化（-ion 构成名词）

items.meaning: able to be differentiated, especially in mathematics
items.meaningCN: 可微分的；可区分的（-able 表示能够）

items.meaning: made distinct, or developed into specialized forms
not yet specialized or separated into kinds
items.meaningCN: 未分化的；未区分的（un- 表否定）

items.meaning: having no interest or concern; neither good nor bad
items.meaningCN: 漠不关心的；平庸的（in- 表否定，词义已转移）

items.exampleCN: 他们对问题的看法不同。

definition_zh: 区分；分化；差异化；（数学）微分；分层
definition_en: the act of telling things apart, the process by which things become unlike, or the mathematical operation of finding a derivative
core_image: 一条原本同质的线分成两支：细胞、产品、课程各自长出不同的形状
scene: 显微镜下，一个细胞分裂成两个形状不同的细胞。Under the microscope one cell divides into two cells of different shapes, and the observer writes differentiation in the notebook.
sceneCN: 这里 differentiation 是「细胞分化」（第 3 个义项：生物学上细胞变为不同形态与功能）；句意：显微镜下，一个细胞分裂成两个形状不同的细胞，观察者在记录本上写下「分化」。图中可辨识物件：显微镜、培养皿、两支不同形状的细胞、记录本。

collocations.zh: A 与 B 之间的区分

senses.title: Telling two things apart
senses.definition: the act of recognizing or stating the difference between two or more things
senses.definitionCN: 识别或说明两个或更多事物之间差别的行为
senses.example: The test rewards fine differentiation between closely related species.
senses.exampleCN: 这项测试奖励对近缘物种的精细区分。
senses.why: The Latin verb differre meant 'to carry apart'. Differentiation is the mental act of carrying two things apart until the gap between them is visible.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词 differre 意为“分开搬运”。differentiation 就是把两样东西在头脑中搬开、直到它们之间的缝隙看得见的行为。

senses.title: The process of becoming unlike
senses.definition: the process by which something develops qualities that separate it from others of its kind
senses.definitionCN: 某物发展出使其区别于同类之特性的过程
senses.example: Regional dialects show gradual differentiation over centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 地区方言在数百年间逐渐分化。
senses.why: Here the word names a process rather than an act of judgment. Two things start alike and drift apart; the -ation suffix makes the drift itself the noun.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词命名的不是判断行为，而是一个过程。两样东西起初相似，慢慢漂开；-ation 后缀使这段漂移本身成为名词。

senses.title: Cells taking on special roles
senses.definition: in biology, the process by which a less specialized cell becomes a distinct cell type
senses.definitionCN: 生物学中未特化的细胞变成特定细胞类型的过程
senses.example: Stem cell differentiation produces muscle, nerve and bone cells.
senses.exampleCN: 干细胞分化产生肌肉、神经与骨细胞。
senses.why: A stem cell carries the same instructions as every other cell. Differentiation is what carries one copy of those instructions down a single path, so the cell stops being interchangeable.
senses.whyCN: 干细胞携带的指令与其他细胞相同。分化就是把其中一份指令搬上一条特定路径，使这个细胞不再可互换。

senses.title: Making a product stand out
senses.definition: in marketing, the design of a product or brand so that buyers perceive it as distinct from rivals
senses.definitionCN: 营销中把产品或品牌设计得让买家觉得它不同于竞争者
senses.example: The firm relies on differentiation rather than low prices.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司靠差异化而非低价取胜。
senses.why: The verb differre also means 'to defer, to set apart'. A marketer sets a product apart from the shelf around it, and the noun names that deliberate setting-apart.
senses.whyCN: 动词 differre 也有“推迟、置于一旁”的意思。营销者把产品从四周的货架上“置开”，这个名词就命名这种刻意的分离。

senses.title: Teaching different levels in one class
senses.definition: in education, the adaptation of tasks and materials to learners of different readiness levels
senses.definitionCN: 教育中为不同准备水平的学习者调整任务与材料
senses.example: Curriculum differentiation lets advanced students move ahead.
senses.exampleCN: 分层课程让进度快的学生继续向前。
senses.why: A single class is treated as a set of groups rather than one mass. The word transfers the biological image of branching paths into the classroom.
senses.whyCN: 一个班级被当作一组组人，而不是一团人。这个词把生物学的“分岔路径”意象搬进了课堂。

senses.title: The derivative in calculus
senses.definition: in mathematics, the operation of finding the rate at which a function changes
senses.definitionCN: 数学中求函数变化率的运算
senses.example: Differentiation of that curve gives its slope at every point.
senses.exampleCN: 对那条曲线求微分，就得到它在每一点的斜率。
senses.why: A difference is a gap between two values. Differentiation shrinks that gap toward zero and asks what ratio survives; the word keeps the original 'difference' at its centre.
senses.whyCN: difference 是两个值之间的间隙。微分把这个间隙缩到趋近于零，再看还剩下什么比值；这个词的中心始终是“差”。

senses.title: Magma splitting into rock types
senses.definition: in geology, the process by which a single magma body separates into chemically distinct melts or rocks
senses.definitionCN: 地质学中单一岩浆体分离成化学成分不同的熔体或岩石的过程
senses.example: Magmatic differentiation explains why one volcano erupts several rock types.
senses.exampleCN: 岩浆分异解释了一座火山为何喷出多种岩石。
senses.why: One parent melt is carried apart into several fractions as minerals crystallize out. The geological sense is the laboratory version of 'becoming unlike'.
senses.whyCN: 一个母岩浆随着矿物结晶被“搬成”几个部分。这个地质义就是“变得不同”在实验室里的版本。

senses.title: Society splitting into roles
senses.definition: in sociology, the division of a society into groups and roles with distinct functions
senses.definitionCN: 社会学中社会分成功能不同的群体与角色的过程
senses.example: Urban growth brought sharper social differentiation.
senses.exampleCN: 城市增长带来更明显的社会分化。
senses.why: Modern societies do not do the same work with the same people. Differentiation names the branching of tasks, and with it the branching of identities.
senses.whyCN: 现代社会不再由同一批人做同样的工作。differentiation 命名的是任务的不断分岔，以及随之而来的身份分岔。

senses.title: Parts specializing inside a system
senses.definition: in systems theory and organization, the specialization of parts that once performed a common function
senses.definitionCN: 系统论与组织理论中原本承担共同功能的各部分走向专门化
senses.example: Biological and organizational systems both gain efficiency through differentiation.
senses.exampleCN: 生物系统与组织系统都通过功能分化提高效率。
senses.why: The counterpart of integration: a system splits into specialized parts that must then be coordinated. The word here measures internal specialization, not difference from outsiders.
senses.whyCN: 它是 integration（整合）的对立面：系统分裂成专门化的部分，随后必须被协调。这里的词衡量的是内部分工，而不是与外部者的差异。

intro.en: Differentiation is a Latin verb plus a Latin noun suffix: differre 'to carry apart', its noun differentia 'a difference', the verb differentiate, and finally -ation. English took the verb from French in the 19th century and built the noun on top of it.
intro.cn: differentiation 是拉丁动词加拉丁名词后缀：differre“分开搬运”，其名词 differentia“差异”，动词 differentiate，最后加 -ation。英语在 19 世纪从法语借入动词，再在其上造出名词。

items.en: The root *bher- meant 'to carry'. It supplies Latin ferre and English bear, and it is the second half of differre, 'to carry apart'.
items.cn: 词根 *bher- 意为“携带”。它给出拉丁语 ferre 与英语 bear，也是 differre“分开搬运”的后半部分。

items.en: Dis- 'apart' plus ferre 'carry' gave differre, 'to carry apart, to differ, to defer'. Its noun differentia named a difference, and the adjective differens named 'different'.
items.cn: dis-“分开”加 ferre“搬运”构成 differre，意为“搬开、相异、推迟”。其名词 differentia 指差异，形容词 differens 指“不同的”。

items.en: The suffix -atio built process nouns from verbs, as in formatio and creatio. Attached to a Latin-derived verb, it yields an English -ation noun naming the process or its result.
items.cn: 后缀 -atio 从动词造出过程名词，如 formatio、creatio。加在拉丁来源的动词上，就得到英语的 -ation 名词，指过程或其结果。

items.en: Old French differencier carried the verb into Middle English as differencien. The noun differentiation appears later, modelled directly on Latin differentia plus -ation.
items.cn: 古法语 differencier 把动词带入中古英语作 differencien。名词 differentiation 出现得更晚，直接仿照拉丁 differentia 加 -ation 构成。

items.en: Calculus gave the word its technical sense: differentiation is the operation inverse to integration. The term spread from French and German textbooks into English in the early 19th century.
items.cn: 微积分赋予这个词技术义：differentiation 是 integration 的逆运算。该术语在 19 世纪初从法语与德语教材传入英语。

items.en: Cell differentiation and social differentiation extend the same image of branching to tissues and to societies. The word now covers both a judgement and a natural process.
items.cn: 细胞分化与社会分化把同一“分岔”意象扩展到组织与社会。这个词现在同时覆盖判断行为与自然过程。

note.en: The look-alike group separates the verb, the adjective and the noun that all sit on the same Latin base. The meaning group compares words about difference, separation and specialization.
note.cn: 形近组区分同一拉丁词基上的动词、形容词与名词；词义组比较表示差异、分离与专门化的词。

entries.definition: to tell apart, to make different, or to find a derivative. It is the verb that lies behind the noun.
entries.definitionCN: 区分、使不同或求导。它是名词背后的动词。

entries.definition: the state of being unlike, or the amount by which two numbers differ. It names the gap, not the process of making one.
entries.definitionCN: 不同的状态，或两数相差的量。它指缝隙本身，而不是制造缝隙的过程。

entries.definition: relating to a difference, or a small amount by which values change. In maths it is the infinitesimal increment.
entries.definitionCN: 与差异有关的，或数值变化的微小量。数学中指无穷小增量。

entries.definition: a difference explicitly recognized or a mark of quality. It stresses the line drawn, while differentiation stresses the process of drawing it.
entries.definitionCN: 被明确认识到的差别，或优异的标志。它强调画出的那条线，而 differentiation 强调画线的过程。

entries.definition: the act of concentrating on one field or function. It is the result of differentiation in biology and in organizations.
entries.definitionCN: 集中于某一领域或功能的行为。它是生物学与组织中分化的结果。

entries.definition: the process of separating and going in different directions. It describes the paths, while differentiation describes the emerging difference.
entries.definitionCN: 分开并朝不同方向发展的过程。它描述路径，而 differentiation 描述显现出的差异。

entries.definition: the ability to see fine differences, or unfair treatment. It is close to sense 01 but carries a social judgement.
entries.definitionCN: 看出细微差别的能力，或指不公平对待。它接近第 1 义项，但带有社会判断。

normalIntro.en: These hooks build the word from differre, 'carry apart', and let the branching image cover cells, products and courses.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩从 differre“分开搬运”搭起这个词，再用分岔意象覆盖细胞、产品与课程。

normal.en: See dis- + ferre: to carry apart. Differentiation is the carrying-apart made into a noun.
normal.cn: 看见 dis- 加 ferre：分开搬运。differentiation 就是“搬开”这个动作变成名词。

normal.en: Picture one stem splitting into two branches: biology calls that cell differentiation.
normal.cn: 想象一根主干分成两枝：生物学把这叫细胞分化。

normal.en: In marketing, the same split happens on a shelf: your product takes its own branch.
normal.cn: 在营销中，同一种分岔发生在货架上：你的产品长出自己的一枝。

normal.en: Connect the maths sense to difference: a derivative measures how fast one value differs from the next.
normal.cn: 把数学义连到 difference：导数衡量一个值相对下一个值变化多快。

normal.en: Remember the pair: differentiation splits, integration joins.
normal.cn: 记住这一对：differentiation 拆开，integration 合拢。

abstract.en: Keep one shape in mind: a single trunk becoming a tree of distinct branches. Every sense is that shape.
abstract.cn: 只记一个形状：一根主干长成一棵分叉的树。每个义项都是这个形状。

abstract.en: Treat the word as a verb of distance: things are carried apart until each has its own name.
abstract.cn: 把这个词当作“距离的动词”：东西被搬开，直到每样都有自己的名字。

abstract.en: Notice that the noun never fully loses 'difference': even calculus is still measuring a gap.
abstract.cn: 注意这个名词从未丢掉“difference”：连微积分也仍在测量一个间隙。

examples.en: Careful differentiation between the two hypotheses is essential.
examples.cn: 对这两个假说作出仔细区分至关重要。

examples.en: Cell differentiation turns a single fertilized egg into a whole organism.
examples.cn: 细胞分化把一个受精卵变成完整的生物体。

examples.en: Differentiation of the function gives the velocity at any moment.
examples.cn: 对该函数求微分就得到任意时刻的速度。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音“地分人先谢”：大家分地、分开、分家，先分才有 differentiation 的区分与分化。

root: 拉丁语 differre“分开搬运”（dis- 分开 + ferre 携带），名词 differentia“差异”；再经法语 differencier 进入英语作 differentiate，加拉丁名词后缀 -ation 构成 differentiation。数学的“微分”义在 19 世纪从微积分术语中固定下来。

sensesIntro.en: One Latin verb, differre, means 'to carry apart'. Everything in this entry is a version of that carrying: a mind separates two species, a stem cell takes one path, a brand is set apart on a shelf, a magma splits into fractions, a calculus operation shrinks a gap toward zero. The nine senses differ only in what is being separated and who does the separating.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个拉丁动词 differre 意为“分开搬运”。本词条的一切都是这个“搬开”的版本：头脑分辨两个物种，干细胞走上一条路径，品牌在货架上被置开，岩浆分成几部分，微积分运算把间隙缩向零。九个义项的差别只在于分开的是什么、以及由谁来分。

core.en: Carrying apart: making what was one into things that are not interchangeable.
core.cn: 分开搬运：把原本是一体的东西变成不可互换的多件事物。

branches.en: Judgement and process: telling apart, and becoming unlike.
branches.cn: 判断与过程：分辨，以及逐渐变得不同。

branches.en: MATTER: cells taking roles, magma splitting into rock types.
branches.cn: 物质：细胞承担角色，岩浆分成不同岩类。

branches.en: MARKET AND SCHOOL: products set apart, lessons layered.
branches.cn: 市场与学校：产品被置开，课程被分层。

branches.en: CALCULUS: a gap shrunk toward zero.
branches.cn: 微积分：间隙被缩向零。

branches.en: SYSTEMS: societies and organizations dividing into functions.
branches.cn: 系统：社会与组织分成不同功能。

intro.en: Differentiation stacks three elements: dif- (a form of dis-), ferre 'carry', and -ation. The items below show the same base with other suffixes, and show where dis- keeps its 'apart' force.
intro.cn: differentiation 叠了三个成分：dif-（dis- 的一种形式）、ferre“携带”、-ation。下列条目展示同一词基配其他后缀，并展示 dis- 保留“分开”力量的情形。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries give the verb and its two nouns. They explain why a word about difference also yields a word about deferring: carrying apart and putting off are the same gesture in time.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语条目给出动词及其两个名词。它们解释了为什么一个关于差异的词同时产生“推迟”义：在时间上把事搬开与推迟，是同一个动作。

items.meaning: the process of distinguishing or specializing
items.example: Differentiation of the two cases took hours.
items.exampleCN: 区分这两个病例花了几个小时。

items.meaning: to distinguish, to make distinct, to find a derivative
items.example: Readers must differentiate fact from opinion.
items.exampleCN: 读者必须把事实与观点区分开。

items.structure: Latin differens, present participle of differre
items.example: The two samples are chemically different.
items.exampleCN: 这两个样本在化学上不同。

items.meaning: the state of being unlike; the amount between two values
items.example: The difference is only a few degrees.

items.meaning: relating to a difference; a small increment
items.meaningCN: 与差异有关的；微小增量
items.example: The differential between the two rates is small.
The accounts differ on one detail.
items.exampleCN: 这些叙述在一个细节上不同。

items.meaning: to put off to a later time
items.example: They deferred the decision until spring.
items.exampleCN: 他们把决定推迟到春天。

items.meaning: to carry back; to point to
items.example: The footnote refers to an earlier study.
items.exampleCN: 脚注指向一项更早的研究。

items.example: The data were transferred to a new drive.
The river made the valley fertile.
items.exampleCN: 这条河使河谷变得肥沃。

latinEntries.meaning: to carry apart; to differ; to defer

definition_zh: 不同地；以不同方式
definition_en: in a way that is not the same as another way or another person
core_image: 两张纸写着同一个句子，一张用蓝笔，一张用红笔，连标点都落得不一样
scene: 母亲把两份作业并排铺开，让两个孩子各自讲一遍思路。Each child solved the puzzle differently.
sceneCN: 这里 differently 指「以不同方式」（第 1 个义项：做法不一样）；句意是每个孩子解这道谜的方式都不同。

senses.title: In another manner
senses.definition: by a method or style that is not the same as the usual one
senses.definitionCN: 用与平常不一样的方法或样式
senses.example: The two machines are built differently.
senses.exampleCN: 这两台机器的造法不一样。
senses.why: The act is the same, but the hand moves by another route.
senses.whyCN: 做的事一样，手却走了另一条路。

senses.title: With another view
senses.definition: with a different opinion or feeling about the same thing
senses.definitionCN: 对同一件事抱着不同的看法或感受
senses.example: After the trip, she thought differently about the city.
senses.exampleCN: 旅行之后，她对这座城市的看法变了。
senses.why: One fact stays put while the mind moves to another seat.
senses.whyCN: 事实没动，脑子却换了个座位。

intro.en: Differently is simply different plus the adverb ending -ly, both built on Latin differre.
intro.cn: differently 就是 different 加上副词词尾 -ly，二者都出自拉丁语 differre。

items.en: Differre meant to carry apart, and so to be unlike.
items.cn: differre 指分开搬运，因而表示不同。

items.en: Different named what is not alike.
items.cn: different 指不一样的东西。

items.en: English borrowed different for unlike things.
items.cn: 英语借来 different，用来形容不一样的事物。

items.en: The ending -ly turned the adjective into a manner word.
items.cn: 词尾 -ly 把这个形容词变成表示方式副词。

items.en: Differently now sits beside verbs of thinking, acting and feeling.
items.cn: 如今 differently 常跟在想、做、感受这类动词旁边。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the differ- shape, while the meaning group offers other ways to say in another manner.
note.cn: 形近组共用 differ 这一形状，近义组则给出「以另一种方式」的其他说法。

entries.definition: not the same as another
entries.definitionCN: 与另一事物不同的

entries.definition: the gap between two things
entries.definitionCN: 两物之间的差别

entries.definition: showing no interest at all
entries.definitionCN: 毫不在意的

entries.definition: in a different way or under other conditions
entries.definitionCN: 以别的方式，或在别的情况下

entries.definition: in several different ways
entries.definitionCN: 以好几种不同方式

entries.definition: each one apart from the others
entries.definitionCN: 各自分开地

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with one sentence written in two hands and end with a mind that changed seats.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一句被两种笔迹写下的话开始，落到一颗换了座位的脑袋。

normal.en: Different plus -ly is all it takes to turn a label into a manner.
normal.cn: different 加 -ly，标签就变成了方式。

normal.en: Two hands, one sentence, two results: that is differently.
normal.cn: 两双手，一句话，两个结果，这就是 differently。

normal.en: Think differently does not mean think less.
normal.cn: think differently 不是想得更少。

normal.en: The adverb hides in the verb: how, not what.
normal.cn: 这个副词藏在动词后面，说的是怎么做，不是做什么。

normal.en: Treat people differently and they will notice before you explain.
normal.cn: 你对人区别对待，他们不等你解释就察觉了。

abstract.en: Picture two pencils drawing the same line in two colours.
abstract.cn: 想象两支铅笔用两种颜色画同一条线。

abstract.en: Picture two people walking to one door by two paths.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人走两条路去同一扇门。

abstract.en: Picture a head turning slowly to look at the same picture.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗脑袋慢慢转过去，看同一幅画。

examples.en: The two sisters dress quite differently.
examples.cn: 这两姐妹的穿着颇为不同。

examples.en: He would have acted differently had he known.
examples.cn: 他要是知道，做法就会不一样。

examples.en: Dogs hear differently from humans.
examples.cn: 狗听声音的方式和人不同。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 differently 记成「地分认特利」：地分了，认出的特点不一样，做事也就用另一种法子。

root: 由形容词 different 加副词词尾 -ly 构成，词根可追到拉丁语 differre（分开搬），由 dis-（分开）与 ferre（搬）组成。它专门修饰动作或状态，说明方式、看法或感受与另一者不同。

sensesIntro.en: From doing the same task by another route, to holding another opinion about the same fact.
sensesIntro.cn: 从换一条路做同一件事，到对同一个事实抱着另一种看法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one sentence written twice, each time by a different hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一句话被写了两遍，每一遍出自不同的手。

branches.en: The first sense is about the manner of doing.
branches.cn: 第一个义项说的是做事的方式。

branches.en: The second sense is about the manner of judging.
branches.cn: 第二个义项说的是判断的方式。

branches.en: Both answer the question how, not what.
branches.cn: 两者回答的都是「怎么做」，而不是「做什么」。

branches.en: A changed view needs no new fact.
branches.cn: 看法变了，并不需要新的事实。

branches.en: Acting and thinking drift apart in their own ways.
branches.cn: 做与想各自以不同的方式偏离。

intro.en: Differently is the adverb branch of the fer- family, with -ly doing the grammatical work.
intro.cn: differently 是 fer 一族的副词分支，真正干活的是词尾 -ly。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin ferre, to carry, reached through differre and different.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 ferre（搬、带），经 differre 与 different 传下来。

items.example: The same word is pronounced differently here.
items.exampleCN: 同一个词在这里读音不同。

items.example: The difference was easy to hear.
items.exampleCN: 这点差别很容易听出来。

items.example: Few can differentiate the two dialects.
items.exampleCN: 很少有人能分清这两种方言。

items.example: She was indifferent to the noise.
items.exampleCN: 她对那阵噪声毫不在意。

items.example: His indifference was hard to bear.

definition_zh: 困难；难题；拮据
definition_en: the state of being hard to do, or a problem that makes something hard
core_image: 一个人抱着一大摞箱子，最上面那只正一点点往一边滑
scene: 楼道很窄，他侧着身子往上挪，额角全是汗。She had difficulty finding the address in the dark.
sceneCN: 这里 difficulty 指「困难」（第 1 个义项：不容易做到的状态）；句意是她在黑暗里很难找到那个地址。

senses.title: The state of being hard
senses.definition: the fact of needing much effort or skill
senses.definitionCN: 需要花费很多力气或本事的情形
senses.example: He had difficulty breathing after the climb.
senses.exampleCN: 爬上去之后他呼吸困难。
senses.why: Nothing blocks the road; the road simply costs more than expected.
senses.whyCN: 路并没有被堵住，只是比预想的更费劲。

senses.title: A particular problem
senses.definition: one specific thing that stands in the way
senses.definitionCN: 挡在路上的某一具体麻烦
senses.example: The team ran into technical difficulties at once.
senses.exampleCN: 团队立刻碰上几处技术难题。
senses.why: The fog around the task hardens into a single object.
senses.whyCN: 任务周围的那团雾，凝成了一个具体的东西。

senses.title: A shortage of money
senses.definition: a period when money is not enough for what is needed
senses.definitionCN: 钱不够应付所需的一段时期
senses.example: The family fell into difficulty after the factory closed.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂关门后，这家人陷入拮据。
senses.why: Here the obstacle is not the task but the empty pocket.
senses.whyCN: 这里的障碍不是任务，而是空掉的口袋。

intro.en: Difficulty comes from Latin difficultas, in which dis- denies facilis, easy.
intro.cn: difficulty 来自拉丁语 difficultas，其中 dis- 否定了 facilis（容易）。

items.en: Facilis meant easy to do, from facere, to make.
items.cn: facilis 指容易做到，源自 facere（做）。

items.en: Difficultas named the quality of not being easy.
items.cn: difficultas 指「不容易」这种性质。

items.en: The word passed through French as difficulté.
items.cn: 这个词经法语 difficulté 传来。

items.en: English difficulty covered both effort and a specific obstacle.
items.cn: 英语 difficulty 同时指费劲与具体的障碍。

items.en: It also came to name a shortage of money.
items.cn: 它还进一步用来指缺钱。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the diffic- shape, while the meaning group names trouble, hardship and a blocking object.
note.cn: 形近组共用 diffic 这一形状，近义组则分别指麻烦、艰苦与挡路之物。

entries.definition: hard to do or to deal with
entries.definitionCN: 难以做到或难以应付的

entries.definition: shy and not confident
entries.definitionCN: 羞怯且缺乏自信的

entries.definition: ease in doing something, or a built place
entries.definitionCN: 做事的便利，或建成的场所

entries.definition: problems that cause worry or effort
entries.definitionCN: 引起担忧或费力的麻烦

entries.definition: suffering caused by a lack of money or comfort
entries.definitionCN: 因缺钱或缺少舒适而受的苦

entries.definition: something that stands in the way of progress
entries.definitionCN: 挡住前进的东西

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from a heavy load slipping to a wallet that cannot cover the week.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一摞滑动的重箱子，走到一只撑不过一周的钱包。

normal.en: Difficult is the adjective, difficulty is the thing it names.
normal.cn: difficult 是形容词，difficulty 是它指的那个东西。

normal.en: Have difficulty doing means the hand hesitates before the work.
normal.cn: have difficulty doing 是说手在活儿前面先犹豫了。

normal.en: With difficulty means it was done, but nobody enjoyed it.
normal.cn: with difficulty 是说做成了，只是没人觉得轻松。

normal.en: One difficulty is a stone; many difficulties are a wall.
normal.cn: 一处困难是块石头，许多困难就是一堵墙。

normal.en: Money trouble borrows the same word as a hard task.
normal.cn: 缺钱的麻烦，借用了「难事」的同一个词。

abstract.en: Picture a stack of boxes leaning a little too far.
abstract.cn: 想象一摞箱子歪得有点过了头。

abstract.en: Picture a nail that bends with every blow.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚钉子，每敲一下都弯。

abstract.en: Picture an empty wallet on a table set for dinner.
abstract.cn: 想象摆好晚饭的桌上放着一只空钱包。

examples.en: She had great difficulty in reading small print.
examples.cn: 她读小字非常吃力。

examples.en: The project ran into difficulties last winter.
examples.cn: 这个项目去年冬天遇上了困难。

examples.en: He hid his financial difficulties from his family.
examples.cn: 他对家人隐瞒了自己的经济困难。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 difficulty 记成「地飞扣体」：地上飞石，扣子又扣得紧，身体处处受难。

root: 来自拉丁语 difficultas，由 dis-（否定）与 facilis（容易，源自 facere「做」）构成，本义是「不容易」。经法语 difficulté 进入英语，先指做事费劲的状态，再指具体的障碍，最后也用来指经济上的短缺。

sensesIntro.en: From the effort a task demands, to one hard obstacle, to a pocket that cannot last the month.
sensesIntro.cn: 从任务索取的力气，到一处具体的障碍，再到一只撑不过月的钱包。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a load that leans a little further with every step.
core.cn: 核心意象：一摞重物每走一步就再歪一点。

chain: THE WALL STANDS IN THE WAY

branches.en: The first sense is the general feeling of effort.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是那种整体的费劲感。

branches.en: The second sense turns that fog into one named obstacle.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把那团雾凝成一处有名字的障碍。

branches.en: The third sense moves the obstacle into the wallet.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把障碍挪进了钱包。

branches.en: Effort and obstacle are the inside and outside of one thing.
branches.cn: 费劲与障碍，是同一件事的里面和外面。

branches.en: A shortage of money is simply the hardest obstacle.
branches.cn: 缺钱不过是那堵最难翻的墙。

intro.en: Difficulty shares its base with difficult and with the fac- words about making and ease.
intro.cn: difficulty 与 difficult 同基，也与 fac 一族表示「做」和「容易」的词同源。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin facere, to make or to do, seen in facilis, easy.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 facere（做），在 facilis（容易）里也能看到。

items.example: The difficulty lies in the last step.
The choice was a difficult one.
He spoke difficultly after the accident.
items.exampleCN: 事故之后他说话很吃力。
计划一开始就遇上困难。
那是个过于省事的解释。

items.meaning: ease, or a place for an activity
items.example: The hotel has a small sports facility.
items.exampleCN: 这家旅馆有个小运动场所。

items.meaning: a power of mind or body, or a teaching body

definition_zh: v. 扩散；传播；散布；使弥漫 adj. 弥散的；分散的；冗长啰嗦的
definition_en: to spread or send out widely through a space or among people; as an adjective, spread thin or long-winded
core_image: 一滴墨落进清水，颜色向四周丝丝散开；同一瓶香水的气味慢慢填满整间屋子
scene: 香气在屋里慢慢散开。The scent begins to diffuse through the room.
sceneCN: 这里 diffuse 是动词，指气味充满一个空间（第 3 个义项：使光或气味弥漫）；句意是香气在屋里慢慢散开。图中可辨识物件：敞口的香瓶、飘散的细线、房间的门框。

pos.zh: 弥散的；分散的；冗长啰嗦的

senses.title: Spread through a medium
senses.definition: of particles, to mix through a gas or liquid by their own motion
senses.definitionCN: （动词）颗粒靠自身运动在气体或液体中混合开来
senses.example: The dye diffuses slowly through the water.
senses.exampleCN: 染料在水里慢慢扩散。
senses.why: A drop of ink opening into threads inside a glass of clear water.
senses.whyCN: 一滴墨在一杯清水里散成丝缕。

senses.title: Send out among people
senses.definition: to circulate ideas or news widely among many people
senses.definitionCN: （动词）把观念或消息广泛传到许多人中间
senses.example: Schools diffuse knowledge beyond the classroom.
senses.exampleCN: 学校把知识传播到课堂之外。
senses.why: A notice copied and handed from one desk to the next.
senses.whyCN: 一张通知被复印后从一张桌子传到下一张。

senses.title: Fill a space
senses.definition: to make light or a smell spread through a whole space
senses.definitionCN: （动词）让光或气味充满整个空间
senses.example: The scent begins to diffuse through the room.
senses.exampleCN: 香气在屋里慢慢散开。
senses.why: An open perfume bottle with faint lines drifting to the doorframe.
senses.whyCN: 一只敞口的香水瓶，细线般的气味飘向门框。

senses.title: Not concentrated
senses.definition: spread over a wide area rather than gathered in one place
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）铺开在大范围而非集中在一处
senses.example: The city has a diffuse pattern of small workshops.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市的作坊分布很分散。
senses.why: Many tiny dots scattered across a map instead of one blob.
senses.whyCN: 地图上许多小点散开，而不是聚成一团。

senses.title: Wordy and rambling
senses.definition: of speech or writing, long and loosely organised
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）（言语或文章）冗长而组织松散
senses.example: His argument was diffuse and hard to follow.
senses.exampleCN: 他的论证冗长散漫，难以跟上。
senses.why: A paragraph whose sentences wander past every margin.
senses.whyCN: 一段文字的句子越过每一道页边四处游荡。

intro.en: Diffuse comes from Latin diffundere, from dis- apart and fundere to pour; its past participle diffusus gave both the verb and the adjective.
intro.cn: diffuse 来自拉丁语 diffundere，由 dis-（分开）与 fundere（倾倒）构成；其过去分词 diffusus 同时给出了动词与形容词。

items.en: Fundere meant to pour.
items.cn: fundere 意为倾倒。

items.en: Dis- meant apart or in different directions.
items.cn: dis- 意为分开、朝不同方向。

items.en: Diffundere meant to pour out widely.
items.cn: diffundere 意为四处倾泻、泼洒开来。

items.en: Diffusus, the past participle, meant spread out.
items.cn: 过去分词 diffusus 意为铺展开的。

items.en: Diffuse entered English for spreading abroad.
items.cn: 十五世纪 diffuse 以向外散布义进入英语。

items.en: Science used diffusion for particles mixing by themselves.
items.cn: 科学界用 diffusion 指颗粒自行混合。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the fuse spelling, and defuse is the classic trap; the near-meaning group names other ways of spreading.
note.cn: 形近组共享 fuse 的拼写，其中 defuse 是最经典的陷阱；近义组是其他表示「散开」的词。

entries.definition: To remove a fuse or calm a tense situation, not to spread.
entries.definitionCN: 拆掉引信或缓和紧张局势，不是「扩散」。

entries.definition: To pour together so things become unclear.
entries.definitionCN: 倒在一起使事情变得不清。

entries.definition: To pour a quality or liquid into something.
entries.definitionCN: 把某种性质或液体注入其中。

entries.definition: To break up and go in different directions.
entries.definitionCN: 分散开来朝不同方向去。

entries.definition: To extend over a larger area.
entries.definitionCN: 扩展到更大的范围。

entries.definition: Long and wandering without a clear order.
entries.definitionCN: 冗长散漫、缺乏条理。

normalIntro.en: Diffuse is dis- apart plus fuse pour: pour it in every direction, and mind the defuse trap.
normalIntro.cn: diffuse 就是 dis-（分开）加 fuse（倒）：往每个方向倒出去；小心 defuse 这个陷阱。

normal.en: Dis- apart plus fuse pour means pour it apart.
normal.cn: dis-（分开）加 fuse（倒）就是往四处倒。

normal.en: The verb ends in a z sound, the adjective in an s sound.
normal.cn: 动词末尾读 z 音，形容词末尾读 s 音。

normal.en: You diffuse a scent but defuse a bomb.
normal.cn: 气味用 diffuse，炸弹用 defuse。

normal.en: Diffusion is the noun, diffusive the adjective.
normal.cn: diffusion 是名词，diffusive 是形容词。

normal.en: A diffuse essay pours words in every direction.
normal.cn: 一篇冗长的文章把词句往各个方向倒。

abstract.en: A drop of ink opening into threads inside a glass of clear water.
abstract.cn: 一滴墨在一杯清水里散成丝缕。

abstract.en: A notice copied and handed from one desk to the next.
abstract.cn: 一张通知被复印后从一张桌子传到下一张。

abstract.en: An open perfume bottle with faint lines drifting to the doorframe.
abstract.cn: 一只敞口的香水瓶，细线般的气味飘向门框。

examples.en: The dye diffuses slowly through the water.
examples.cn: 染料在水里慢慢扩散。

examples.en: Schools diffuse knowledge beyond the classroom.
examples.cn: 学校把知识传播到课堂之外。

examples.en: His argument was diffuse and hard to follow.
examples.cn: 他的论证冗长散漫，难以跟上。

dict_mnemonic.text: diffuse ＝ dif-（＝dis-，分开）＋ fuse（拉丁语 fundere「倾倒」，同根 confuse、infuse、profuse）＝往四处倒出去，「扩散、传播」；形容词指「弥散的、冗长的」。别和 defuse（拆引信、缓和）混。

root: 拉丁语 dis-（分开）＋ fundere（倾倒）→ diffundere（四处倾泻）→ 过去分词 diffusus → 英语 diffuse

sensesIntro.en: One drop poured in every direction: ink in water, news in a town and a sentence that will not stop.
sensesIntro.cn: 一滴往每个方向倒出去的东西：水里的墨、镇上的消息，以及一句停不下来的话。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a drop of ink poured into clear water and opening outward in every direction at once
core.cn: 核心意象：一滴墨倒进清水，同时朝每个方向向外散开

branches.en: A drop of ink opening into threads inside a glass of clear water.
branches.cn: 一滴墨在一杯清水里散成丝缕。

branches.en: A notice copied and handed from one desk to the next.
branches.cn: 一张通知被复印后从一张桌子传到下一张。

branches.en: An open perfume bottle with faint lines drifting to the doorframe.
branches.cn: 一只敞口的香水瓶，细线般的气味飘向门框。

branches.en: Many tiny dots scattered across a map instead of one blob.
branches.cn: 地图上许多小点散开，而不是聚成一团。

branches.en: A paragraph whose sentences wander past every margin.
branches.cn: 一段文字的句子越过每一道页边四处游荡。

intro.en: Diffuse is dif- plus fus-; the pour root also builds confuse, infuse, profuse and effusive.
intro.cn: diffuse 由 dif- 加 fus- 构成；倾倒这个词根也造出 confuse、infuse、profuse 与 effusive。

latinIntro.en: Latin fundere means to pour, diffusus spread out and spargere to scatter.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 fundere 意为倾倒，diffusus 意为铺展开的，spargere 意为撒开。

definition_zh: adj. 扩散的；有扩散能力的；传播广泛的；（文风）散漫冗长的
definition_en: tending to spread widely through a space or among people; of style, sprawling and wordy
core_image: 两只连通的玻璃瓶，中间的隔板一抽，色雾就自己往对面匀过去
scene: 这种气体扩散得很快。The gas is highly diffusive.
sceneCN: 这里 diffusive 是「有扩散倾向的」（第 1 个义项）；句意是这种气体很容易扩散开来。图中可辨识物件：两只连通的玻璃瓶、逐渐变均匀的色雾、中间的隔板夹。

pos.zh: 扩散的；有扩散能力的；传播广泛的；（文风）散漫冗长的

senses.title: Apt to spread
senses.definition: having a tendency to spread through a surrounding medium
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）有在周围介质中散开的倾向
senses.example: The gas is highly diffusive.
senses.exampleCN: 这种气体扩散得很快。
senses.why: Two joined glass jars where coloured mist evens out once the slide is pulled.
senses.whyCN: 两只连通的玻璃瓶，隔板一抽色雾就匀开。

senses.title: Reaching many people
senses.definition: spreading ideas or influence widely through a community
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）把观念或影响广泛散布到人群中
senses.example: The press has a diffusive influence on opinion.
senses.exampleCN: 报刊对舆论有广泛的传播影响。
senses.why: One headline repeated on every phone in a crowded carriage.
senses.whyCN: 一条标题在拥挤车厢里每部手机上重复出现。

senses.title: Sprawling in style
senses.definition: of writing, spreading thinly over many words
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）（文章）用很多字把内容摊得很薄
senses.example: His diffusive prose hides the main point.
senses.exampleCN: 他散漫的文风把要点藏了起来。
senses.why: A page of long sentences with the key claim buried in the middle.
senses.whyCN: 一页长句，关键主张埋在中间。

intro.en: Diffusive adds the tendency suffix -ive to Latin diffusus, spread out, from diffundere, to pour apart.
intro.cn: diffusive 是在拉丁语 diffusus（铺展开的）上加表倾向的后缀 -ive，diffusus 来自 diffundere（往四处倾倒）。

items.en: Fundere meant to pour.
items.cn: fundere 意为倾倒。

items.en: Diffusus meant poured out and spread.
items.cn: diffusus 意为倒开、铺展开的。

items.en: The suffix -ivus marked a tendency.
items.cn: 后缀 -ivus 表示一种倾向。

items.en: Diffusive appeared for things apt to spread.
items.cn: 十七世纪 diffusive 出现，指易于散开的事物。

items.en: Writers on heat and gases spoke of diffusive power.
items.cn: 研究热与气体的作者谈到「扩散能力」。

items.en: Critics call a sprawling prose style diffusive.
items.cn: 批评家把散漫的散文风格称作 diffusive。

note.en: The look-alike group is the diffus- family plus effusive; the near-meaning group names other spreading qualities.
note.cn: 形近组是 diffus- 家族加上 effusive；近义组是其他表示「蔓延」性质的词。

entries.definition: The process of spreading itself.
entries.definitionCN: 扩散这一过程本身。

entries.definition: Capable of being spread through a medium.
entries.definitionCN: 能在介质中散开的。

entries.definition: Pouring out feelings too freely.
entries.definitionCN: 过分外露地倾泻情感。

entries.definition: Present throughout a place or thing.
entries.definitionCN: 遍布某个地方或事物。

entries.definition: Extending over a wide area or range.
entries.definitionCN: 覆盖广阔的范围。

entries.definition: Long and wandering in style.
entries.definitionCN: 文风冗长散漫。

normalIntro.en: Diffusive is diffuse plus -ive: not the spreading itself but the readiness to spread.
normalIntro.cn: diffusive 就是 diffuse 加 -ive：不是扩散这件事，而是随时要扩散的性子。

normal.en: Diffuse plus -ive means apt to diffuse.
normal.cn: diffuse 加 -ive 就是「易于扩散的」。

normal.en: Diffusive names the tendency, diffusion the process.
normal.cn: diffusive 说倾向，diffusion 说过程。

normal.en: Effusive pours out feelings, diffusive pours out matter.
normal.cn: effusive 倾泻情感，diffusive 倾泻物质。

normal.en: Diffusively is the adverb.
normal.cn: diffusively 是副词。

normal.en: A diffusive style spreads words thinly.
normal.cn: 散漫的文风把词句摊得很薄。

abstract.en: Two joined glass jars where coloured mist evens out once the slide is pulled.
abstract.cn: 两只连通的玻璃瓶，隔板一抽色雾就匀开。

abstract.en: One headline repeated on every phone in a crowded carriage.
abstract.cn: 一条标题在拥挤车厢里每部手机上重复出现。

abstract.en: A page of long sentences with the key claim buried in the middle.
abstract.cn: 一页长句，关键主张埋在中间。

examples.en: Helium is a highly diffusive gas.
examples.cn: 氦是极易扩散的气体。

examples.en: The press has a diffusive influence on opinion.
examples.cn: 报刊对舆论有广泛的传播影响。

examples.en: His diffusive prose hides the main point.
examples.cn: 他散漫的文风把要点藏了起来。

dict_mnemonic.text: diffusive ＝ diffuse（扩散，dif-「分开」＋ fuse「倒」）＋ -ive（有…倾向的）＝「易于扩散的」；引申指传播广泛，也指文风散漫冗长。名词是 diffusion，副词是 diffusively。

root: 拉丁语 fundere（倾倒）→ diffundere（四处倾泻）→ diffusus（铺展开的）＋ -ivus（倾向）→ 英语 diffusive

sensesIntro.en: A readiness to pour outward: a gas crossing a gap, an opinion crossing a town, a sentence crossing every margin.
sensesIntro.cn: 一种往外倒的倾向：穿过缝隙的气体、穿过小镇的观点、越过每一道页边的句子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two joined jars whose coloured mist evens itself out the moment the slide between them is pulled
core.cn: 核心意象：两只连通的瓶子，中间的隔板一抽，色雾就自己匀开

branches.en: Two joined glass jars where coloured mist evens out once the slide is pulled.
branches.cn: 两只连通的玻璃瓶，隔板一抽色雾就匀开。

branches.en: One headline repeated on every phone in a crowded carriage.
branches.cn: 一条标题在拥挤车厢里每部手机上重复出现。

branches.en: A page of long sentences with the key claim buried in the middle.
branches.cn: 一页长句，关键主张埋在中间。

branches.en: Both spread without anyone pushing them.
branches.cn: 两者都不用人推就自己散开。

branches.en: Both reach far but lose sharpness on the way.
branches.cn: 两者都传得很远，却在路上失去了锋利。

intro.en: Diffusive is dif- plus fus- plus -ive; the same parts build effusive, pervasive and expansive.
intro.cn: diffusive 由 dif- 加 fus- 加 -ive 构成；同样的部件造出 effusive、pervasive 与 expansive。

latinIntro.en: Latin fundere means to pour, diffusus spread out and -ivus marks a tendency.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 fundere 意为倾倒，diffusus 意为铺展开的，-ivus 表示倾向。

definition_zh: 消化；理解吸收；摘要
definition_en: to break down food in the body, to take in information, or a short summary of a longer text
core_image: 一大块面包泡在温水里，慢慢散成看不见的细末
scene: 他饭后靠在椅背上，等胃把那顿硬面包慢慢化开。It takes hours to digest such a heavy meal.
sceneCN: 这里 digest 指「消化」（第 1 个义项：把食物分解吸收）；句意是这么油腻的一顿要几个小时才能消化。

senses.title: To break down food
senses.definition: to change food in the body into something it can use
senses.definitionCN: 在体内把食物变成身体能用的东西
senses.example: Some people cannot digest milk easily.
senses.exampleCN: 有些人不容易消化牛奶。
senses.why: A large piece must become small before the body can take it.
senses.whyCN: 大块的东西必须先变碎，身体才拿得走。

senses.title: To take in ideas
senses.definition: to read or hear something and make it your own
senses.definitionCN: 读过或听过之后，把它变成自己的东西
senses.example: Give the class time to digest the new rule.
senses.exampleCN: 给学生一点时间消化这条新规则。
senses.why: The mind chews in the same slow way the stomach does.
senses.whyCN: 脑子咀嚼的节奏，和胃一样慢。

senses.title: A short version of a text
senses.definition: a small collection of the main points of longer writing
senses.definitionCN: 把较长文字的主要意思收成一小份
senses.example: The magazine prints a monthly digest of new research.
senses.exampleCN: 这本杂志每月印一份新研究摘要。
senses.why: What has been digested comes out shorter and easier to carry.
senses.whyCN: 被消化过的东西，出来时更短也更好带。

intro.en: Digest comes from Latin digerere, to carry apart, from dis-, apart, and gerere, to carry.
intro.cn: digest 来自拉丁语 digerere（分开搬运），由 dis-（分开）与 gerere（搬、带）构成。

items.en: Gerere meant to carry or to manage a burden.
items.cn: gerere 指搬运，也指料理一份负担。

items.en: Digerere meant to separate things and set them in order.
items.cn: digerere 指把东西分开，再排好顺序。

items.en: Medical writers used it for the body softening food.
items.cn: 医学作者用它形容身体把食物化开。

items.en: English digest covered food, and soon also books.
items.cn: 英语 digest 先指食物，很快也用于书。

items.en: The noun came to mean a compact collection of articles.
items.cn: 名词义后来指把文章收成一小册。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the gest- ending, while the meaning group covers absorbing, summarising and blending in.
note.cn: 形近组共用 gest 结尾，近义组则覆盖吸收、概括与融会。

entries.definition: to move away from the main subject while speaking
entries.definitionCN: 讲话时离开正题

entries.definition: relating to the process of digesting food
entries.definitionCN: 与消化食物有关的

entries.definition: easy for the body to break down
entries.definitionCN: 身体容易分解的

entries.definition: to take in liquid, energy or knowledge
entries.definitionCN: 吸收液体、能量或知识

entries.definition: a short account of the main points
entries.definitionCN: 主要内容的简短叙述

entries.definition: to take in and make part of oneself
entries.definitionCN: 吸收并化为自身的一部分

normalIntro.en: These hooks go from bread softening in the stomach to a thick magazine folded into a thin summary.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从胃里化开的面包，走到一本厚杂志被折成一页薄摘要。

normal.en: The verb says dye-JEST; the noun says DYE-jest.
normal.cn: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前，意思也随之分工。

normal.en: The stomach digests food and the mind digests a chapter.
normal.cn: 胃消化食物，脑子消化一章书。

normal.en: A digest is what is left after all the chewing.
normal.cn: digest 是嚼完之后剩下的那一小份。

normal.en: Easy to digest is praise for soup and for prose.
normal.cn: easy to digest 既能夸汤，也能夸文章。

normal.en: Indigestion is the body refusing a hurried meal.
normal.cn: 消化不良，是身体拒绝一顿太急的饭。

abstract.en: Picture a slice of bread slowly losing its shape in water.
abstract.cn: 想象一片面包在水里慢慢失去形状。

abstract.en: Picture a thick book pressed down to ten thin pages.
abstract.cn: 想象一本厚书被压成十张薄纸。

abstract.en: Picture a reader nodding slowly as a hard idea settles.
abstract.cn: 想象一个难懂的念头落定，读者慢慢点头。

examples.en: He read the report and digested its main points.
examples.cn: 他读完报告，吸收了其中的要点。

examples.en: This soup is easy to digest.
examples.cn: 这种汤很容易消化。

examples.en: The digest arrives every Friday morning.
examples.cn: 这份文摘每周五早上送到。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 digest 记成「袋子嚼死它」：袋子里的东西一层层嚼碎，就是消化。

root: 来自拉丁语 digerere，由 dis-（分开）与 gerere（搬、带）构成，本义是把东西分开搬走、排好次序。医学上用它指身体把食物化开，于是有了「消化」；把厚材料化短，则有了「摘要」；把知识化进脑子，就是「理解吸收」。

sensesIntro.en: From food broken into pieces, to ideas taken in slowly, to a long text folded into a few pages.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被拆碎的食物，到慢慢吃进去的想法，再到把长文折成几页。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a large solid piece slowly breaking into fine parts.
core.cn: 核心意象：一大块结实的东西，慢慢散成细末。

branches.en: The first sense is the work of the stomach.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是胃干的活。

branches.en: The second sense hands the same work to the mind.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把同样的活交给脑子。

branches.en: The third sense keeps only the reduced result.
branches.cn: 第三个义项只留下被压缩后的成果。

branches.en: Body and mind both need time before they can use what comes in.
branches.cn: 身体和脑子都需要时间，才能用上进来的东西。

branches.en: A summary is proof that someone has already digested the text.
branches.cn: 摘要就是有人已经把全文消化过的证据。

intro.en: Digest gathers the gest- family, words about carrying, ordering and breaking down.
intro.cn: digest 聚起 gest 一族词，围绕搬运、排序与分解。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin gerere, to carry, with dis- meaning apart.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 gerere（搬、带），前缀 dis- 表示分开。

items.meaning: to break down and take in
the process of breaking down food

items.example: The digestive system is slow at night.
items.exampleCN: 夜里消化系统运转得慢。

items.example: He took a pill for indigestion.
items.exampleCN: 他吃了一片治消化不良的药。

items.example: The food was fully digested by noon.
items.exampleCN: 到中午食物已完全消化。

items.meaning: in the middle of breaking down
items.exampleCN: 蛇在消化时会静卧不动。
